notes: Two branches from the sintered solid solution: (1) NN-rich side, BNT stabilises AFE_O phases -> reversible AFE-FE switching -> fully reversible strain for AFE_O R (x=0.16, ~0.44%) -> actuator potential; (2) x>=0.2, PE and relaxor AFE phases with APNRs -> near-linear response.
